description: Organic blob shapes with an 8-handle radius editor.

faqs.a: The eight values are the horizontal and vertical radius of each of the four corners: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.
faqs.q: What do the eight sliders control?

howto: Drag the eight sliders to shape each corner.
